subject: Observability onramp: dashboards, tracing hooks & alert mapping for Stellardata
messages:
From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@stellardata.com>

Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@stellardata.com>
Date: 2028-11-12T08:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Observability onramp: dashboards, tracing hooks & alert mapping for Stellardata

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Stellardata is excited to move into implementation. We want a short, pragmatic onramp focused on three high-value outcomes in the first two sprints:

- Baseline dashboards for 5 user-facing eng services (latency, error rate, 95th pct)
- Tracing hooks in the auth & payments flows so we can correlate user journeys end-to-end
- Alert mapping: give us a starter taxonomy and routing so our on-call isn’t flooded on day one

We have a kickoff window the week of Nov 20. Before that, could you share a working agenda and any templates (runbook, alert matrix, dashboard checklist) so we can prep? Also flag any prerequisites for our infra team (agent versions, span headers, sampling recommendations).

Thanks — Lina

--
Lina Gomez
Senior Engineering Manager, Observability
Stellardata
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

Date: 2028-11-12T10:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Observability onramp: dashboards, tracing hooks & alert mapping for Stellardata

Hi Lina — great to hear the team is ready. Attached is a concise kickoff packet to keep the first two sprints focused (PDF agenda + runbook template + alert mapping CSV). Quick notes and asks: 

1) Kickoff agenda (30–45 min): introductions, scope (which services), success criteria, prerequisite checklist, timeline for sprint 1, owner assignments.
2) Prereqs for your infra team:
   - Agent: redwood-agent v2.1+ (minor config changes for span headers)
   - Tracing headers: please ensure X-Trace-Id / X-Span-Id are propagated and not stripped by your gateway
   - Sampling: start at 5% adaptive for payments/auth, 1% for bulk services; we can bump after baseline
3) Deliverables for sprint 1: shared dashboard bundle, 1 trace integration for auth flow, draft runbook for P0/P1 errors.

Proposed kickoff slot: Nov 21, 10:00–10:45 PT. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short pre-kickoff survey for your SREs so we can tailor the checklist.

Attachments: redwood_obs_onramp_agenda.pdf, runbook-template-v2.md, alert-mapping-stellardata.csv

Best,
Priya

--
Priya Natarajan
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-11-14T09:32:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Observability onramp: dashboards, tracing hooks & alert mapping for Stellardata

Priya — forwarding my prep notes for the kickoff. High-level suggestions to keep the implementation tight: 

- Dashboard checklist: keep to 7 KPIs per service (latency p50/p95, error rate, traffic rate, CPU, mem, request queue depth) so the dashboards remain actionable.
- Tracing hooks: instrument a single code path in auth (login -> token issue -> profile fetch) with manual span naming and a small semantic attribute set (user_id, session_id, device). We should ship a code snippet in the kickoff to remove ambiguity.
- Alert taxonomy: propose the three-tier approach in the CSV (P0: service crash / complete outage; P1: user-impacting errors >1% over baseline; P2: degradation signals). Route P0 to on-call + escalations; P1 to product SRE + owner; P2 to weekly digest.

Open asks for the kickoff:
- Can you have an SRE and a dev lead from your payments team join the first 30 minutes? They own the auth/payment hooks.
- Any compliance constraints around sampling or retaining traces for >30 days? If so, we need to align on KMS and retention policy early.

I added the runbook-template-v2.md to the attachments — it's trimmed to just the fields we actually use during playbook execution.

Thanks,
Marissa

Hi all — Nov 21 10:00 PT works for the majority. We’ll have Samir (SRE lead) and Anika Rao (payments dev lead) join the first 30 minutes. A couple quick clarifications for the survey so your team can prep: 

1) Retention/compliance: we can retain traces for 90 days internally, but we cannot send raw PII fields to third-party retention; please include the minimal required attributes in your template.
2) For sampling — 5% on payments is fine to start. If you can share the snippet for the X-Trace-Id propagation and the delta header we prefer (x-stellar-span), that will speed the integration.

We’ll accept the attachments as-is and will complete the pre-kickoff survey by EOD Nov 20. Thanks for the packet — looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Lina
